From Soft & Wet · Price: a slow bubble that must touch the target.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: release a bubble that floats 20 ft. It pops on the first creature or object in its path and steals one property for 1 round: friction (it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} if it moves, @Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates), sound (silenced) or water (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1}, @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 5: Bubbles float 40 ft and you can steal sight (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{blinded}, @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 9: Surge: the stolen property lasts 1 minute.
  • 13: Two bubbles per action.
  • 17: Steal the air: the creature is suffocating for 1 round (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
